days.top_line: Iran rejected US terms but Hormuz talks kept going all day, keeping Brent oil above **$106** and pulling Wall Street and Indian markets lower. Floods pushed Odisha's evacuees past
Sunday was tense: UK police foiled a bomb plot near a base used in US strikes on Iran. Kohli passed 15,000 ODI runs, and Anthropic claimed major AI science breakthroughs.
